name: MN-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with an 11-point partisan lean
Incumbent Kelly Morrison running with a large fundraising edge
Challenger Tyler Bass has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price the Democratic side near 95%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly Democratic: an 11-point lean, a favorable environment, incumbency, and a clear money advantage for Morrison, while Bass shows no reported fundraising. Markets price this near-certain for the incumbent, so the forecast stays in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Morrison showing a tighter-than-expected race would be the main signal to watch.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kelly Morrison, a Democratic incumbent, seeks a second term in a Minneapolis-suburban district that leans Democratic by about 11 points. She has raised roughly $1.4 million and holds over $400,000 on hand, while Republican Tyler Bass has reported no fundraising. No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets put Morrison's chances near 95%, and the fundamentals point to a comfortable margin in the low twenties. With no evidence of a competitive challenge, the race is rated Safe Democratic, though uncertainty is somewhat elevated given the absence of polling.
